newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stockpile solicits rubber offers, sets meeting.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stockpile solicits rubber offers, sets meeting.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center Friday issued a draft solicitation for bids on 32,000 long tons of rubber for sale in its first initial offering on January 8, 1997.

The stockpile also said an industry meeting will be held at its headquarters on December 4 from 0900 EST/1400 GMT to 1130/1630 on the soliicitation, the contracting method selected, standard industry practices and overall market conditions.
It said written comments are due by December 2.
